data.content_ref: inline:Kind: abstraction. 3d82a99f1546 abstracts SRC_005's covering principle: in monotone local majority dynamics on random 3-regular graphs, consensus failure is governed by locally stable mixed obstructions whose boundary is a matching and whose prevalence is set by the 2-core of the initial color class. It is refuted if the isolated artifact's obstruction set is not characterized by a monotone cut measure or if its prevalence does not reduce to the 2-core size Θ(n^{1/3}).
